rows.label: Engine type
rows.value: Liquid-cooled four-stroke inline-four; 16 valves; double overhead camshafts

rows.label: Unrestricted rated power
rows.value: 70 kW (93.9 mechanical hp) at 12,000 rpm; a 35 kW A2 conversion is available

rows.label: Clutch
rows.value: Wet multi-plate assist/slipper; cable-operated, manual clutch

rows.label: Chain slack
rows.value: 25–35 mm; engine stopped, neutral, sidestand on firm level ground; check midway between sprockets at several positions; do not ride if slack exceeds 50 mm

rows.label: Maximum weight capacity
rows.value: 168 kg; includes rider, passenger, luggage and accessories

rows.label: Maximum luggage weight
rows.value: 7 kg; includes luggage and added accessories

rows.label: Front suspension
rows.value: 41 mm Showa Separate Function Big Piston upside-down fork

rows.label: Tread service limits
rows.value: Front 1.5 mm; rear 2.0 mm; manual service limits, check local legal requirements

rows.label: Brakes
rows.value: Two-channel Anti-lock Braking System (ABS); dual 310 mm front discs; 240 mm rear disc

rows.label: Valve clearance values
rows.value: Not specified in the owner’s manual; use the model-specific workshop manual

rows.label: Battery
rows.value: YTZ10 or FTZ10S; 12 V, 8.6 Ah (10-hour rating) / 9.1 Ah (20-hour rating)

rows.label: Lighting
rows.value: LED headlight, tail/brake light, indicators and licence plate light

rows.label: Other fuse ratings
rows.value: 30 A, 20 A, 15 A, 10 A, 7.5 A; locations and circuit assignments are not stated in the specifications

fluids.label: Engine Oil
fluids.capacity: 2.3 L after draining; 2.6 L with filter; 3.0 L after disassembly
fluids.spec: SAE 10W-30; API SJ or higher, excluding Energy Conserving and Resource Conserving oils; JASO T 903 MA.

fluids.label: Coolant
fluids.spec: Pro Honda HP Coolant; use the owner’s manual procedure.

fluids.label: Fuel Tank
fluids.spec: Unleaded petrol, 91 RON or higher; up to 10% ethanol.

fluids.label: Drive Chain Lubricant
fluids.spec: O-ring-compatible chain lubricant; SAE 80 or 90 gear oil if unavailable.
